messages:
Sam: Heads-up — proposing a go/no-go sync 2026-03-28 15:00 PT to vet prelaunch stability fixes + RFC-221 (networking changes). Can people confirm availability?
Maria: Available. Suggest 45m. Draft agenda: smoke tests, canary metrics, rollback plan, RFC-221 walk-through, final cut decision.
Devon: I can join at 15:00 but only for ~30m. If we need more time, we should schedule a follow-up.
Priya: Put me down. I will bring canary dashboards and traffic split numbers. Quick question: any blockers on the request-batching fix?
Sam: Thanks — @Ben can you give a quick status on batching? Also earliest agenda draft below.
Ben: Batching fix in QA; one flaky test around kv-cache expire. Hoping to merge today. Will keep canary toggle so we can disable if needed.
Sam: Agenda (draft):
```
1) Quick roll call and goals (5m) — owner: Sam
2) Preflight checklist & smoke test results (10m) — owner: Priya
3) Canary metrics and traffic plan (10m) — owner: Priya
4) RFC-221 networking changes: risks + mitigations (10m) — owner: Maria
5) Rollback and runbook review (5m) — owner: PlatformOncall
6) Cut decision & next steps (5m) — owner: Sam
```
Devon: Can we add "review rollback script" to agenda explicitly? +1 from me.
Maria: Yes, please. Also request owners drop a 1-2 line digest in this thread before the meeting.
Priya: I'll post the canary metric snippets and preflight pass/fail thresholds. Also note: Dedicated customers may need a heads-up email if we toggle traffic.
Sam: Attendance so far: @Sam, @Maria, @Devon, @Priya, @Ben, @PlatformOncall. @PlatformOncall — can oncall join to confirm rollback steps?
PlatformOncall: ops-bot: Will join and standby for rollback. Zoom link will be the same as the release room.
Ben: Quick PR ping: PR #4321 (canary toggle + batching fix) needs review/approval — @Devon @Maria can you take a look?
Devon: I'll review after standup and aim to approve by 11:30 PT.
Maria: I'll skim and flag anything obvious this afternoon.
Sam: If PR is not merged by 13:00 PT we'll mark "canary toggle manual" in the runbook and proceed with a manual gating step. Preflight checklist (please update status):
```
- [ ] PR #4321 merged and smoke-tested
- [ ] Canary toggles configured
- [ ] Low-latency canary traffic ramped to 5% for 1h
- [ ] Key SLOs monitored (latency, error rate)
- [ ] Rollback script smoke-tested
- [ ] Stakeholder notify list updated
```
Priya: Adding the metric thresholds now: median latency < 120ms, p95 < 450ms, error-rate < 0.5% during canary.
Ben: If QA is green I'll aim to merge by 13:00 PT so we have at least 1h of canary before the meeting.
Sam: Final ask: please add your ETA/blocks in this thread. I'll compile attendee roster and publish the final invite at 13:30 PT. Cheers.
